# Scaliente

## What is Scaliente?
Scaliente is a profit-tracking application for Shopify stores. It reconciles orders, product costs, shipping, payment fees, taxes and advertising spend to calculate net profit. Shopify orders arrive through webhooks. Advertising spend is synchronized once or twice daily depending on the source and can also be refreshed manually.

## Key Features
- Net profit and margin dashboard recalculated as Shopify orders arrive
- Advertising spend tracking across exactly five platforms: Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest and Snapchat
- Product-level analytics with profit per SKU
- Multi-store management from one account
- Multi-currency support with daily ECB exchange rates
- CSV report exports
- Shopify Web Pixel attribution from the date the pixel is activated
- Data hosted in Europe
- AI customer-service inbox that combines connected email with Shopify order, delivery, dispute and customer-history context while keeping replies under human control

## Pricing
- Discovery: €0/month, up to 50 orders and one advertising platform
- Lite: €39/month, up to 100 orders and two advertising platforms
- Starter: €89/month, up to 300 orders
- Growth: €149/month, up to 1,500 orders
- Scale: €249/month, unlimited orders
- Paid plans include a seven-day trial. Annual billing is discounted by 20%.
